_about: Public-domain Edward Wix (1802-1866), Archdeacon of Newfoundland, for the Word Hoard: his sermons (1831-1832), a retrospect of the SPG in North America (1833) and Six Months of a Newfoundland Missionary's Journal (1836). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 93 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
